publisher: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division

access.automation: DCCA links a Business Data List Builder, while BREG is transitioning systems and says additional services will arrive later; no supported API or unattended route is documented.
access.fees: The service is described as purchasing custom lists, but current pricing was not established on the reviewed official DCCA pages.

fields: Historical official inventory describes business lists and addresses/officers/trade names/marks; the current page does not publish a machine schema, field dictionary, or person-free option.
active_status_semantics: The registry supports good-standing checks and annual reports for active entities, but registration standing is not proof that an establishment currently operates.
statewide_completeness: BREG maintains registrations across many entity types, but not all businesses must register; list-builder scope during the 2026 portal transition is not established as a complete statewide extract.
address_and_zip: Business lists may include addresses, but ZIP presence and address roles are not contractually defined; officer, member, manager, and agent addresses require exclusion.
redistribution: Purchase and public inspection do not establish retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication, or redistribution rights; portal terms require separate review.
temporal_refresh: A historical state inventory described weekly bulk data, but current BREG pages announce a July 2026 system transition; current cadence, continuity, deletions, replay, manifest, and checksums are unresolved.
